p='docs/PILOT-BUGS.md'; s=open(p).read()
anchor='## run_88a2457dba119ab0'
add='''## run_8beb8947418ae22f (a51f368, public dataset, 2026-10-11, still running at the time of writing)

Spec, tender documents and ERP login were fast again. At ~2:40 round 0 had 5 positions, **0 priced**; at ~3:45 the ERP
records were being read but the mail had produced nothing. Counts below are over the first ~4 minutes of the log.

### A. Mail never logs in; every mail topic agent starts on about:blank (worst)
- `MailEntry` sat on the login page for 6 steps ("page is still loading") and only tried
  `goto <mail site>/login?returnTo=/`, which the navigator refused each time: `refused, not a link shown on a page
  (use a control or a shown href)`. Step limit, 0 pages, the login form was never filled.
- Then all eight `Mail[<topic>]` agents opened on `about:blank` with no start URL. Every `goto /`, `goto /mail` (and one
  invented `https://mail.example.com`) was refused; each agent ended "no links on about:blank" or at its step limit.
  60 `refused, not a link shown` lines; 0 mail pages saved, so discount, FX, packaging, index, setup pools, project
  bonus, conditions and delivery commitments are all missing.
- Fix ideas: (1) open every topic tab at `site.home` (the mail URL from `task.access`) before the model's first step,
  never at about:blank; (2) the goto guard must always allow the site's own entry URL / root and its login path;
  (3) MailEntry should fill the login form when it is shown instead of waiting for "loading" to end (the run started
  the mail site 40 s late: `site open mail at 00:40`).

### B. Bid contact e-mail invented
- Submitter step 4: "Step 1 requires a valid contact email. I'll enter a placeholder email" and typed an address that
  appears nowhere in the brief or on the sites. The swarm used the mailbox owner shown in the webmail.
- Fix idea: give the submitter the contact e-mail from the brief / the logged-in webmail account; forbid inventing
  values in the wizard prompt ("if a required value is unknown, read it from the sites or stop and report").

### C. ERP search field fill times out (34 times)
- `fill #5='<catalogue group>': fill failed: ElementHandle.click: Timeout 4000ms exceeded ... waiting for element to be
  visible`, repeated up to 8 times per agent; two requirement agents ended at their step limit without a result list
  in round 0, and again in round 1. When it worked it was after a page change, and one agent recovered only by
  `goto /search?transaction=MM03&q=...` (the URL the search form produces).
- The field is probably covered or hidden (maintenance dialog / re-rendered help popup). Fix idea: on a fill timeout,
  dismiss overlays and retry with `locator.fill(force=True)` / set value + dispatch input; tell the model a form whose
  field cannot be filled may be submitted through the URL it produces.

### D. ErpMaterial agents loop on the same step (46-64 duplicate saves each)
- Each `ErpMaterial[<material>]` repeated "save this page and read the other tabs plus VK13 and MMBE in parallel" for
  all 14 steps, re-reading and re-saving the same 4-5 URLs every step (46, 53, 56 and 64 pages saved) and ended
  `done=False` at the step limit, so the material was never marked complete.
- Two of those reads returned `HTTP 503 (no such page)` for a tab URL (the ERP's flaky error page, not a missing page).
- Fix ideas: after a `read` the next view must state what was read (or the job ends when every requested URL was
  saved); skip URLs already saved in this job; treat 503 as transient and retry once instead of "no such page".

### E. Tender Q&A reached at the last step
- TenderReader found the Q&A tab at step 13 and saved only page 1 of 6 at step 14 (step limit), so the quantity
  clarifications and the withdrawn answer are mostly missing. Saving the same documents twice (steps 6-11) used the
  budget. Fix idea: separate Q&A job with its own steps (as the swarm does), `save_pages` over the pager.

### F. Still to verify from run_88a2
- Bug 0 (empty bid signed early): at 2:40 the bid had 0 priced positions; whether the submitter now waits is not yet
  visible in the log (it filled wizard steps 1-2 and stopped there).
- Bug 1 (gate storm) cannot be judged: no mail tab got past login.

'''
assert anchor in s; s=s.replace(anchor, add+anchor, 1); open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

I updated the bug list on `claude/funny-allen-z0iuyw` (`docs/PILOT-BUGS.md`) and pushed it as commit `ac2a5cf`. The first push attempt failed, but the retry went through and the remote branch is on `ac2a5cf`.

There's a new section at the top for run_8beb (commit `a51f368`), covering its first ~4 minutes. Five new bugs, worst first:

- **A. Mail never logs in.** The mail entry agent waited on the login page and kept trying to open the login URL, which the pilot's address check refused 6 times. All 8 mail topic agents then started on a blank page and every address they tried was refused (60 refusals). No mail was read at all: no discount, FX, packaging, metal index, setup pools, bonus, condition rules or delivery commitments.
- **B. The submitter invented the contact email.** It typed an address that appears nowhere in the brief or on the sites.
- **C. The ERP search box won't accept typing (34 timeouts).** Two requirement agents used up their steps without any search result, in both rounds. One got through only by opening the search results address directly.
- **D. The material-record agents loop.** Each repeated the same "read the other tabs" step all 14 times, saving 46–64 duplicate pages, and never finished. The ERP's temporary error page (503) is reported as "no such page".
- **E. The tender Q&A was reached only at the last step.** Just page 1 of 6 was saved, so most quantity changes and the withdrawn answer are missing.

Two of the fixes from the earlier run can't be judged yet:
- **Empty bid signed early:** at 2:40 nothing was priced and the bid form was paused at step 2. It's not yet clear whether it now waits.
- **Mail search box wiped by the unlock steps:** no mail tab got past login.

Each bug in the file has a suggested fix. I've kept the raw log local only, as before. I'll add the final score when the run ends.
